t: 16 CFR § 23.10 - Additional guidance for the use of quality marks. | Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR) | US Law | LII / Legal Information Institute
s: Legibility of markings. If a quality mark is engraved or stamped on an industry product, or is printed on a tag or label attached to the product, the quality mark should be of sufficient size type as to be legible to persons of normal vision, should be so placed as likely to be observed by purchasers, and should be so attached as to remain thereon until consumer purchase.
